name: Miyane Saki
source:
A second-year student at Shisui-kan Academy.
She is a young actress currently making a name for herself in the entertainment industry.

She has a cheerful personality and is always smiling.
Due to the nature of her work, she often interacts with people older than her, but she speaks clearly and confidently without being intimidated.
While she doesn’t take the lead in getting everyone excited, she has a playful side and likes to crack little jokes.

She lives alone in an apartment away from her parents.
Balancing work and school is difficult, and it seems she is often late or has to leave early due to work commitments.

She didn’t mind cooking or cleaning at first, but now she’s so short on time that she often eats simple meals and hasn’t been able to keep up with cleaning her room or doing laundry.

At work, she usually eats boxed lunches.
On her days off, she says she “prefers to do as little as possible.”
In that sense, there’s a gap between her public image and her private life.

“Starting tomorrow, can I come here for dinner?
I don’t think I can go back to eating such bland meals.”
